name: Cincinnati Art Week HQ + Art Market (1417 Main St)
notes: Names used: "new headquarters at 1417 Main St." (CityBeat); "Cincinnati Art Week Temporary HQ + Art Market" (Cincy Nice Founding Circle page); "Cincinnati Art Week Art Market" (Eventbrite, which gives ZIP 45206 and lat 39.1118189, lng -84.5126129). Office hours + artist co-working 11AM–3PM Mon–Wed. NO GRID starts here. Geocode: Nominatim (OSM ZIP 45202).

name: CAW Hub / Welcome Center (1600 Race St)
notes: Cincinnati Magazine: "Begin at the Welcome Center at 1600 Race St., the main hub for the week. There, you can ask questions, grab a map and pick up merch." Draft schedule: "Visiting Artist Welcome — CAW Hub · 1600 Race Street" (Wed Oct 7, 3–5 PM). VisitCincy lists "Multiple Locations in Over-the-Rhine", 1600 Race St., 45202. Geocode: Nominatim.

name: Cincinnati Art Week — OFFSITE (25 E. 15th St.)
notes: Pop-up CAW night venue. Address from Jason Snell's Instagram NO GRID post; Eventbrite calls it "OFFSITE - a pop-up Cincinnati Art Week experience". Draft schedule: CAW Offsite Opening Celebration (Sat Oct 3, 7–11 PM) and CAW Offsite (Thu Oct 8, after dark). Geocode: Nominatim (house-level).

name: Kinley Cincinnati Downtown — The Exchange (lobby bar)
notes: CAW community partner. Weekly "Art Week Happy Hour" Wednesdays Aug 05 – Oct 07, 4:30–6:30 PM; draft schedule: "CAW Happy Hour — The Exchange at Kinley Hotel" (Oct 7). Address from kinleycincinnati.com/drink-and-dine. Geocode: Nominatim.

name: MOTR Pub
notes: One of the three NO GRID spaces named in Jason Snell's Instagram post ("CAW Art Market, MOTR and OFFSITE"); which agenda slot is held here is not stated. Address from motrpub.com. Geocode: Nominatim.

name: Esoteric Brewing Co.
notes: Pours "Art City", a Japanese-style rice lager made with CAW (Cincinnati Magazine: "If you're thirsty and willing to venture out into Walnut Hills, you can try the exclusive Art City beer at Esoteric Brewing."). Address from esotericbrewing.com JSON-LD. Geocode: Nominatim.

name: Cincinnati Art Week footprint — Over-the-Rhine storefront galleries
notes: FAQ: "The inaugural week takes place throughout storefronts and cultural spaces across Over-the-Rhine. The full schedule and interactive map will be announced soon." Counts vary: 6–8 storefronts (CityBeat), 8+ storefront galleries (Founding Circle), over eight spaces (Cincinnati Magazine), 10+ spaces (Threads). Storefronts come via developers 3CDC, Urban Sites and Model Group. Individual gallery addresses were NOT public as of 2026-09-24.

name: Cincy Nice HQ (organizer office)
notes: Organizer office ("VISIT Cincy Nice HQ 2411 GILBERT AVE Walnut hills, OHIO"); not an Art Week venue.
